Possibly the most important aspect is realizing it isn't definite. There is a large spectrum. Research helped me as well. But this isn't to say I'm aromantic. I love cuddling & kissing & touching my partner. Im also celibate until marriage, but it hasn't been difficult.

Yes yes yes! There is no such thing as "being asexual enough" or more/less than someone else. If you identify. You identify. It's not a competition. Im proud of you for asking yourself these important questions. You also don't NEED to identify as something. It's a choice ❤
